deckspec.differs_from_raw: the kind takes chart {type, data} beside insights[]; the raw form is a chart content item (chart_value {type, data}) in the body placeholder, or diagram {type, data} inside a compose segment

data_contract.description: categories: string array; series: [{name, values: number[]}]. The value axis starts at zero unless a value is negative; y_min / y_max zoom it (the axis is then kept visible; y_min above the smallest bar is rejected, hiding over half of it reports chart.axis_not_zero). Up to 16 bars are labelled by default (value on each bar, no value axis or gridlines; data_labels: false or style.show_values: false opts out). sort: desc|asc|none (default desc for a single series of non-time, non-ordinal categories). orientation: "horizontal" for rankings or category names over ~14 characters. highlight: category indices or names painted accent1 (single series). Slide fields: title, chart {type, data}, insights[] (1–6 bullets beside the chart), source, takeaway.

insights: Replace with what the chart shows.
slides.source: Illustrative sample data; replace with the real source
slides.title: Replace with the action title this bar chart supports
